description: This Java source file defines the ContentEvents class, which handles content-related event processing such as updating keywords for all content items within the OFBiz framework. It includes permission checks, transaction management, content querying, and indexing logic.

classes.name: ContentEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for handling content events within the OFBiz application, notably for updating content keywords.

methods.name: updateAllContentKeywords
methods.description: Updates or adds keywords for all content entries by querying the Content entity, checking permissions, and managing transactions. It processes content items in batches, indices keywords, and handles errors and transaction rollback appropriately.
